card.capacity_status_quote: Q1 revenue would have been meaningfully higher, but demand continues to outpace our growing supply.
card.demand_direction_quote: Our outlook for server CPU demand has improved over the last 90 days, and we expect a strong year of double-digit unit growth for the industry and for us, with momentum extending into 2027.
card.pricing_power_quote: ASPs—we have moved pricing to offset some of the cost increases we have seen over the last couple of quarters, but it is not the biggest driver of our revenue outlook.
card.guidance_direction_quote: we are guiding Q2 to a range of $13.8 to $14.8 billion, up 2% to 9% sequentially
card.constraint_owner_quote: Today, it is about how quickly we can add manufacturing capacity and scale our supply to meet enormous demand for our products.
